'''Katla Helvintr, the Wyrmslayer Queen,''' was a [[Fenrisian]] who commanded the [[Rogue Trader House]] [[House Helvintr|Helvintr]] and her daughter [[Astrid Helvintr|Astrid]] served as her second in command.{{Fn|1a}} 

==History==
[[Image:Helvintr.jpg|thumb|right|190px|{{PAGENAME}}{{Fn|2a}}]]
[[House Helvintr]] is part of the [[Davamir Compact]] [[Rogue Trader]] alliance, which was led by [[Davos Lamertine]] of [[House Lamertine]]. However the leadership of the Compact can be taken by those who have the strength to do so. Katla is among those that Davos feared will soon move to take the title from him. This is doubly so, after his Daughter, [[Evelyne Lamertine]] died, who was chosen to be his heir. Left with little choice, Davos has now chosen his son [[Erastus Lamertine|Erastus]] to take her place. Both Davos and Katla knew, however, that Erastus has not proven himself yet, like Evelyne had.{{Fn|1a}}

Katla Helvintr was seriously injured in battle with [[Genestealers]] aboard her flagship [[Wyrmslayer Queen]], and at first everyone thought that she died,{{Fn|1b}} but later it turned out that she was alive{{Fn|1c}}{{Fn|2}} - cured by her old advisor - a [[gothi]] [[Bodil]].{{Fn|1c}} She later went on to discover a second stable route through the [[Great Rift]] dubbed the [[Attilan Gate]].{{Fn|2b}} She has since become allied with  [[Inquisitor]] [[Rostov]] in his quest to stop the [[Hand of Abaddon]].{{Fn|3}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Human]] of [[Terra]] during the [[Horus Heresy]].

===History===
Living his whole life on [[Terra]] as a bureaucratic enumerator in an agriculture district of [[Hokkaidan Hive]]{{Fn|7}}, when the [[Siege of Terra]] finally began Katsuhiro was [[Conscript|Conscripted]] into the [[Imperial Army]]'s [[Kushtun Naganda]] and stationed at Bastion 16 outside the Helios Gate of the [[Imperial Palace]].{{Fn|1a}} Receiving virtually no training and a mere [[Lasgun]], Katsuhiro and his fellow Conscripts including [[Myzmadra|Myz]] and [[Ashul|Doromek]] fended off attacks by [[Beastmen]], [[Mutant]]s, [[Traitor Guard|Traitor Army]], and other horrors in the early days of the Siege.{{Fn|1b}} Later when the [[Death Guard]] arrived, Katsuhiro and his unit were only saved thanks to a counterattack led by [[Jaghatai Khan]]. During these battles Katsuhiro went from a barely trained conscript to a hardened veteran, enduring untold horrors and becoming distrustful of Myz and Doromek. When another soldier in the unit declared the duo traitors, he was mysteriously found dead.{{Fn|1c}}

After weeks of brutal fighting and eruptions of plague at Bastion 16 Katsuhiro's unit was finally overrun by a large-scale Death Guard attack led by [[Plague Tower of Nurgle|Plague Towers]]. Facing death, Katsuhiro retreated into a tunnel under Bastion 16 where he overhead Myz and Doromek plotting to destroy the fort with explosives. Katsuhiro slipped away from the [[Alpha Legion]] [[Operative]]s and only escaped back into the palace thanks to a counterattack from the Helios Gate led by [[Sanguinius]]. As he was attended to by medics inside the Palace, he spotted Doromek disappearing into the crowd of survivors. He declared Doromek a traitor, but his attending medic thought him delirious and subdued him with drugs.{{Fn|1e}}

Despite surviving the first battles of the Siege, Katsuhiro was by no means safe. He was transferred to the Palatine Arc region of the Palace, enduring [[Death Guard]] biological warfare in a region now nicknamed Poxville. Katsuhiro would have been slain in a traitor attack had [[Euphrati Keeler]] not appeared.{{Fn|2}} Now a grizzled veteran of the Siege, Katsuhiro acted as a ''de facto'' authority figure spreading the [[Imperial Cult]] to other desperate Army troopers at the Marmax bastion of the walls against repeated traitor assaults. During the battle, his life was saved by the [[Blood Angels]] officer [[Baeron]]. Baeron was grievously wounded during the battle, and his last act was to put Katsuhiro in command with a plea to hold the line at all costs.{{Fn|3a}} He was present when [[Shiban Khan]] arrived at the walls holding an abandoned [[Oriens Katsuhiro|infant]] alongside the dying [[Imperial Army]] Lieutenant [[Cole]], 

While not a veteran, Katsuhiro nonetheless became hardened by the later stage of the Siege and his fear had become replaced by religious zeal. He later encountered [[Garviel Loken]], who was searching for [[Euphrati Keeler]]. By this point Katsuhiro still had possession of the baby Shiban had found and was now overseeing religious militias in a desperate struggle against the traitors. Katsuhiro had taken command simply because all of his superior officers had since died, and if one of higher rank appeared he would consent to their authority.{{Fn|4}}

Later in the final stages of the Siege, Katsuhiro, still with the baby, was part of [[Euphrati Keeler]]'s exodus from the [[Sanctum Imperialis]] to an unknown destination and guided by a mysterious light.{{Fn|5}} He is part of the group that makes it to the [[Hollow Mountain]], and informs [[Cypher|The Lord Cypher]] of the fear the refugees feel during the [[Death Guard]] attack.{{Fn|6}}

After the Siege of Terra ended, Katsuhiro and the infant boy found themselves in a camp for some time until [[Shiban Khan]] managed to arrange passage for Katsuhiro, the boy and a woman named [[Elantra Katamana]] back to the [[Dragon Nations]] where Katsuhiro had been born.{{Fn|7}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a high-ranking member of the [[Alpha Legion]] during the [[Great Crusade]] and [[Horus Heresy]]. Like the rest of his legion, he was physically modified to be near-identical to his [[Primarch]], [[Alpharius]].{{Fn|1a}}

===History===
Originally serving as a [[Headhunter]], Silonius eventually rose to become a [[Harrowmaster]] and one of [[Alpharius]]' favorite commanders alongside [[Ingo Pech]] and [[Mathias Herzog]]. In preparation for the [[Solar War]] that would see the Alpha Legion's drive on the [[Sol System]], Silonius was charged with a vital mission by Alpharius himself. Using Legion [[Librarian]]s, Silonius seemingly had his mind switched with that of Alpharius while the Primarch took on the Harrowmasters identity. Alpharius, now taking on the persona of Silonius, infiltrated [[Terra]] and set the stage for the Alpha Legion's arrival by activating sleeper cells and assets. The real Silonius, commanding from the [[Battle Barge]] ''[[Alpha]]'', spent the next year in stasis as he powered down his fleet to gradually drift into the Sol System in order to avoid detection.{{Fn|1a}}

Silonius led the Alpha Legion fleet of over 200 ships in the subsequent [[Battle of Pluto]]. However when Alpharius himself seemingly was killed by [[Rogal Dorn]], he ordered a retreat and seemed unconcerned with his Primarch's death, stating that the entire Legion is one.{{Fn|1b}}

'''Kelbor-Hal''' was the [[Fabricator-General]] of the [[Adeptus Mechanicus|Mechanicum]] during the [[Great Crusade]] and [[Horus Heresy]].{{Fn|2}} He joined forces with [[Horus]] and assisted the renegades with all of the technology available to mankind, forming the [[Dark Mechanicum]].

===History===
Kelbor-Hal was present when the [[Emperor]] first arrived on [[Mars]], and, while the Master of Mankind was widely celebrated by most of his colleagues, he was deeply distrustful of the [[Terra]]n warlord.{{Fn|2}}

Hal and his followers were among those who refused to see the Emperor as the avatar of the [[Omnissiah]], instead only seeing a False prophet who had subordinated the Mechanicum under the [[Imperium]]'s heel with lies and falsehoods. Kelbor-Hal feared that the Emperor and His forces were going to strip away the autonomy [[Mars]] had enjoyed dating back all the way to the [[Dark Age of Technology]]. Despite this disdain, eventually Kelbor-Hal was able to rise through the Tech-Priest hierarchy to become [[Fabricator-General]] by the late [[Great Crusade]]. He gathered around him a circle of like-minded [[Magos|Magi]] including [[Urtzi Malevolus]], [[Lukas Chrom]], and [[Melgator]].{{Fn|2}}

At the outbreak of the [[Horus Heresy]], there were high tensions between the various [[Magos|Magi]] governing Mars. Seeing an opportunity for a powerful new ally, [[Horus]] sent [[Regulus (Dark Mechanicum)|Regulus]] into this powderkeg and he was able to convince Kelbor-Hal to join forces with the Traitors on the condition that the autonomy of the Mechanicum be ensured, that the [[STC]]s the [[Sons of Horus]] had captured from the recently subjugated but technologically advanced [[Auretian Technocracy]] be handed over to him, and that the [[Vaults of Moravec|Martian Vaults of forbidden technology]] be opened for Mechanicum use. In the ensuing [[Schism of Mars]] between rebel and loyalist Mechanicus forces, Kelbor-Hal's new [[Dark Mechanicum]] emerged victorious.{{Fn|2}} However after the Schism Mars was blockaded by the [[Imperial Fists]] and Kelbor-Hal was contained on the Red Planet for the next several years, forcing to rely on his [[Nine Disciples]] to act as his emissaries in Horus' fleets.{{Fn|3}} Also during the Heresy, he oversaw the construction of the ''[[Furious Abyss]]'' in the shipyards around [[Jupiter]] for the [[Word Bearers]], after which it was used to attempt to destroy the [[Ultramarines]] [[Legion]] and their [[Adeptus Astartes Homeworld|homeworld]], [[Macragge]].{{Fn|1}}

Following the [[Solar War]], the loyalist blockade of Mars was lifted and Kelbor-Hal was able to take direct command of the Dark Mechanicus war effort again. Arrogant and gaudy, he attempted to take credit for many of the achievements of [[Perturabo]] and [[Sota-Nul]] during the [[Siege of Terra]].{{Fn|4}} During the Siege of the [[Imperial Palace]], Kelbor-Hal remained behind on Mars to oversee its reconstruction and muster fleets against the anticipated arrival of [[Roboute Guilliman]]. However, upon examining chronological distortions eminating from Terra due to the [[Warp]] presence on the world, Kelbor-Hal was assailed by an immense input of data which told him the true name of the [[Dark King (Entity)|Dark King]], a figure whom he had regarded as the true [[Omnissiah]]. He then began to scream,{{Fn|5a}} as the Dark King was revealed to be the Emperor.{{Fn|5b}}

Keritraeus.wikitext:
{{UltramarinesPortal}}
'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an [[Ultramarines]] [[Primaris Space Marines|Primaris]] [[Librarian]] who served in [[Lord Commander]] [[Guilliman]]'s [[Indomitus Crusade]].{{Fn|1}}

In his service to the Crusade, Keritraeus was part of [[Lieutenant (Space Marine)|Lieutenant]] [[Cassian]]'s Ultramarines strike force, which destroyed the [[Chaos Cults|flesh-cults]] that had overthrown the [[Imperium]]'s rule on [[Knossa]]. Afterwards, they left the world to rejoin the main forces of the Indomitus Crusade, but disaster struck when their [[Strike Cruiser]] [[Primarch's Sword]] was hit by a [[Warpstorm]]. Though the Strike Cruiser eventually escaped from the storm, it was left heavily damaged and the Ultramarines found themselves stranded in the '''Kalides System'''. With the Primarch's Sword unable to enter the [[Warp]], Cassian consulted with Keritraeus and [[Chaplain]] [[Dematris]] on their best course of action. After much consideration, it was decided they would go to the nearby Imperium world [[Kalides Prime]], so they could repair the Primarch's Sword and rejoin the Indomitus Crusade. Cassian also agreed with Chaplain Dematris, that they might face a world in the grips of [[heresy]] and the Lieutenant ordered his forces to prepare for battle, as they began to travel to Kalides Prime.{{Fn|1}}

Kernax Voldorius.wikitext:
{{AlphaLegionPortal}}
'''Kernax Voldorius''' was a [[Daemon Prince]] and "'''Strikemaster'''" of the [[Alpha Legion]].{{Fn|1a}}{{Fn|2}}

==Overview==
A cruel and unholy warlord, he was responsible for the deaths of numerous billions when he woke the [[Bloodtide]] in 034.[[M38]]{{Fn|3}} on the fane-worlds of [[Gan-Barak]].{{Fn|6b}} Voldorius went on to commit further atrocities on the worlds of [[Kento]], [[Loran]] and [[Blind Hope]]. He led the Alpha Legion in the [[Assault on Zoran]] on [[M41]].{{Fn|4}} He was counted among the greatest foes the [[White Scars]] ever had and managed to escape several of the Chapter's notorious [[Master of the Hunt|Masters of the Hunt]].{{Fn|1}}

When [[Hunt for Voldorius|he was pursued]] by the 51st Master of the Hunt, [[Kor'sarro Khan]], Voldorius headed for the imperial bastion-world [[Quintus]] where he brought the corrupt authorities under his sway.{{Fn|6a}} Here, his troops engaged in a guerrilla war with [[Raven Guard|Raven Guard Marines]] under [[Kayvaan Shrike]] who later joined forces with the White Scars. Together, the Marines and their heroes confronted the Daemon Prince and his mutated retinue in the imperial cathedral of the capital where he made his last stand.{{Fn|1a}}

Although he relished in combat and inflicted severe losses to the loyalists, he was eventually torn up by Shrike and impaled on a statue of the Emperor where Kor'sarro Khan beheaded him{{Fn|1a}} in the streets of the planetary capital [[Mankarra]].{{Fn|5}}{{Fn|Conflicting sources}} His skull joined the many severed heads that adorn the passage to the White Scars' Fortress Monastery.{{Fn|1b}} As a Daemon Prince, however, Voldorius could not be truly killed, and would one day return to terrorize mankind.{{Fn|6c}}

=={{Endn|Conflicting sources}}==
The exact location where Voldorius was beheaded is uncertain: in the novel [[Hunt for Voldorius (Novel)|Hunt for Voldorius]], he is defeated in the [[Cathedral of the Emperor's Wisdom]]{{Fn|6c}}, however, the [[Codex: Chaos Space Marines (8th Edition)|8th Edition Chaos Space Marines codex]] states that he was killed in the streets outside.{{Fn|5}}

Keshiel.wikitext:
{{BloodAngelsPortal}}
'''Keshiel''' was a [[Chaplain]] in the [[Blood Angels]] [[Chapter]]{{Fn|1a}}, during the [[Kallius Insurrection]].{{Fn|1b}}

The [[Blood Angels]] took serious losses in that campaign, before they were allowed to disengage and return to [[Baal]]{{Fn|1b}}. However before the Blood Angels could leave the current [[System]] they were in, the Chapter was mercilessly ambushed{{Fn|1c}} by the [[Black Legion]]. To make matters even worse, the Blood Angels became bereft of Remael's leadership, after a barrage struck and completely destroyed the Bloodcaller's bridge{{Fn|1d}}. The Chapter would be saved, though, after the [[Angels Numinous]] arrived and drove off the Black Legion{{Fn|1e}}. Due to their battles in the [[Kallius Insurrection]] and the ambush, the Blood Angels' [[Space Marine Captain|Captain]]s were nearly all dead. Only Captain [[Dante]] still lived and he was chosen to succeed Remael, as the next [[Chapter Master]].{{Fn|1a}}  

Keshiel was among the few [[Chaplain]]s who still lived and sought to deny [[Dante]] the chance to become [[Chapter Master]]. He soon made his intentions known, in a [[Chapter Council]] meeting, in which only Keshiel, Dante, the [[High Chaplain]] [[Bephael]] and the [[Sanguinary Priest]]s [[Estius]] and [[Gallion]] remained alive. The Chaplain truly believed that the young and inexperienced Dante was not worthy of the command, and, as was customary in such situations, [[Council of Blood and Bone]] should rule instead. High Chaplain Bephael was the highest ranking member of Chapter Council members standing in judgement of Dante and decided the Captain would decide. He asked Dante if he would lead the Blood Angels by becoming Chapter Master{{Fn|1a}}. Dante replied that he would and Keshiel had no choice but to accept Dante as the Chapter's new commander.{{Fn|1f}}

'''{{PAGENAME}}''', later to become the second bearer of the name [[Archamus]]{{Fn|4}}, was a member of the [[Imperial Fists]] during the [[Horus Heresy]].

===History===
A [[Space Marine Sergeant|Sergeant]] within the elite [[Huscarls]] guard of [[Rogal Dorn]], Kestros faithfully served [[Archamus I|Archamus]]. When Archamus was killed by [[Alpharius]] during the [[Battle of Pluto]], Kestros became the new commander of the Huscarls. He thereafter took on the name of Archamus in memory of his commander.{{Fn|2}}

Kestros, as Archamus, next appeared questioning [[Vulkan]] when the Primarch emerged from the [[Webway]] on [[Terra]].{{Fn|2}} He was at Dorn's side throughout the final phase of the [[Solar War]], leading his [[Huscarls]] into battle against the [[Daemons]] of [[Samus]] aboard the ''[[Phalanx]]''.{{Fn|3}} He continued to serve his role during the [[Siege of Terra]], overseeing operations in Dorn's Grand Borealis command center in the [[Bhab Bastion]].{{Fn|4}}

Following the fall of the Bhab Bastion to Traitor forces and Dorn's departure alongside the [[Emperor]] in the assault on the ''[[Vengeful Spirit]]'', Archamus was named the commander of the remaining loyalist forces on Terra.{{Fn|6}} He oversaw a desperate last stand at the Palatine Bastion when they hear the prayer chanting of [[Actae]] which offers some hope to their situation.{{Fn|7}}

Kezellon.wikitext:
{{BloodAngelsPortal}}
'''Kezellon''' was a [[Death Company Dreadnought]] in the [[Blood Angels]] [[Chapter]]{{Fn|1}}, who was once known as '''Cassor the Damned'''.{{Fn|2a}}{{Fn|3}}
==History==
Before he was interred within a [[Space Marine Dreadnought|Dreadnought]], Kezellon was the [[Space Marine Captain|Captain]] of the [[Blood Angels]]' [[2nd Company (Blood Angels)|2nd Company]]{{Fn|1}} and was considered to be one of the finest warriors that the [[Chapter]] had ever produced{{Fn|2a}}. He was a champion with his sword and undefeated in battle, until Kezellon was cut in half while fighting the [[Aeldari]]. Though he was left for dead by the [[Xenos]], his sheer will kept Kezellon alive until he was interred within a Dreadnought{{Fn|1}}. Kezellon then continued his service with the 2nd{{Fn|1}} for almost another three hundred years{{Fn|2a}}, and became known as the fury of his [[Space Marine Company|Company]]. Many of the [[Imperium]]'s foes met their ends at Kezellon's Dreadnought hands{{Fn|1}}, until he fell to the [[Black Rage]] while fighting on [[Lowfang]]{{Fn|2a}}. This led Kezellon{{Fn|1}} to be inducted into the [[Blood Angels]]' [[Death Company]], where he became known by various titles{{Fn|2a}}, including '''Ancient Cassor'''{{Fn|1}}, '''Cassor the Damned''', '''Cassor the Mad''' and '''Cassor the Chained'''.{{Fn|2a}} 

As Cassor, he could barely tell friend from foe and was too dangerous to unleash unless the [[Blood Angels]] were given cause to. One such event occurred during the [[Cryptus Campaign]] in 998.[[M41]], where he was part of a [[Death Company]] detachment sent to [[Asphodex]] to aid the [[Chapter]]'s [[1st Company (Blood Angels)|1st Company]], which was being overwhelmed by [[Hive Fleet Leviathan]]'s [[Tyranids]]. After saving [[Space Marine Captain|Captain]] [[Karlaen|Karlaen's]] life, when he was about to be killed by the [[Spawn of Cryptus]], Cassor met his final while fighting a [[Carnifex]]{{Fn|2b}}. When the Campaign was over, the Blood Angels' [[Chapter Master|Commander]], [[Luis Dante]], read the names of those who died and came across Cassor's. Dante remembered when the [[Death Company Dreadnought]] had been known as Kezellon, though, and decided that with his second honorable death, the former [[Space Marine Captain|Captain]]'s original name would be returned to him. However Dante hoped that Kezellon's deeds would be remembered, under both of his names.{{Fn|1}}

It is said that Invocatus won this steed along with his [[Bloodstorm Helm]] long before he became famous in his Legion, after completing the mysterious deeds known as the Road of Eight Bloody Steps. '''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Captain]] of the [[Imperial Army]]'s 4th [[Clandestine Orta]] during the [[Horus Heresy]].{{Fn|1}}

===Biography===
An experienced officer who was utterly loyal to the [[Imperial Truth]], Hassan was assigned by [[Malcador (Character)|Malcador]] to recover the [[Wikipedia: Rosetta Stone|Rosetta Stone]] from the clutches of a traitor cell in [[Wikipedia: Egypt|Gyptus]]. Thinking he had failed when he obtained a mere rock, after the mission Hassan was shown the [[Webway Gate]] and hall of artifacts under the [[Imperial Palace]] by Malcador himself. He was then given the choice by Malcador to join his [[Malcador's Chosen|chosen]], which he immediately accepted.{{Fn|1}}

Hassan later appears among the [[White Scars]] [[stormseer]]s watching over the fallen [[Thousand Sons]] [[sorcerer]] [[Revuel Arvida]], who was rendered unconscious after guiding the Scars through the [[Webway]] to aid in their return to [[Terra]]. Although they are suspicious of his presence, he promises the White Scars that [[Malcador]] will help Arvida and that they have been waiting for him to arrive.{{Fn|2}}

Khalid Hassan later appeared to greet [[Alivia Sureka]] and her family as they arrived on Terra and stated that he was instructed to bring her to The Sigillite.{{Fn|3}} He subsequently recruited Sureka for a mission at the behest of Malcador during the [[Siege of Terra]].{{Fn|4}} He next appeared before [[Sigismund]] to give him a [[Black Blade of Sigismund|Black Blade]] on the [[Emperor]]'s own order.{{Fn|6a}} When [[Ilya Ravallion]] and [[Jangsai Khan]] asought to treat the grievously wounded [[Jaghatai Khan]] after his battle with [[Mortarion]], Hassan informed them that Malcador had been summoned and would attempt to aid the wounded Primarch the best he could.{{Fn|6b}}

By the final stages of the Siege of Terra, Hassan had risen to be first amongst Malcador's Chosen. He along with [[Moriana]] and [[Zaranchek Xanthus]] were the three to meet with the Sigillite before his ascension to the [[Golden Throne]] as the Emperor went to fight [[Horus]] aboard the ''[[Vengeful Spirit]]''. Malcador telepathically passed on many projects to the three so they may continue his work, and Hassan received one named [[Terminus Decree|Terminus]] which dealt with the anti-[[Astartes]] weapon of [[Basilio Fo]]. Hassan then passed the thought-file onto Xanthus.{{Fn|7}}

Hassan alongside the [[Custodian]] [[Ios Raja]] were next ordered by [[Vulkan]] in escorting [[Ollanius Persson]] and [[Argonauts|his group]] out of the Throneroom.{{Fn|8a}} However along the way they became separated during the chaotic fighting, and Hassan and Raja next sought out Fo and Amon after it was reported he was never delivered to Custodes custody.{{Fn|8b}} During their journey, their [[Orion Gunship]] was brought down by a massive [[Daemonic]] creature and sent into a deep ravine.{{Fn|8c}}

Hassan and Raja survived the crash, and were able to make it to the [[Sigillite's Retreat]] and stop [[Amon Tauromachian]] from activating [[Basilio Fo]]'s [[Terminus Decree|bio-weapon]], believing the loyalist cause not yet lost due to the transmission being spread by [[Actae]].{{Fn|9a}}

Hassan survived the Heresy, and oversaw the implementation of Malcador's final projects on [[Titan (Moon)|Titan]] in its aftermath.{{Fn|9b}}

Sergeant '''Kham Bell''' was a warrior in [[Rogue Trader]] [[Janus Darke]]'s mercenary force [[Darke's Company]].{{Fn|1a}}

==History==
Bell was from [[Crowe's World]]. He was one of the first to follow [[Janus Darke]], and [[Navigator]] [[Simon Belisarius]] considered this to have been the making of him. He followed Darke across the galaxy, and was one of the few who survived when they visited [[Typhon (Quarantined World)|Typhon]].{{Fn|1a}}
